method: Read exact installed feature metadata; inspect the corresponding pinned OSM snapshot objects; decode current NPOL packed geometries from neighborhoods.bin; project pairs to EPSG:32632 for overlap-area ratios; compare parent identity to the INS 2082-code sector registry. Polygon overlap percentages are geometric source checks, not legal-boundary determinations. OSM tag/record snapshot digests are SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators).

features.recommendation: Do not use حي السلام as the primary name for this smaller polygon without evidence that the two identities are the same; keep unresolved.
features.reason: The official INS/OSM sector named حي السلام (code 115958) covers this polygon completely, but the target is only a 0.033 km² landuse=residential subarea without a code or place=neighbourhood tag. Its OSM official_name=Cité Essalem is a community-maintained tag, not independent proof of a distinct official neighborhood. The same Arabic label could refer to the larger sector or to a subarea.
features.evidenceGap: A municipal or other authoritative address/map source naming Cité Essalem as a separate locality and clarifying whether it has an Arabic name distinct from the enclosing حي السلام sector. If it is merely a residential subarea of that sector, retire it as a duplicate picker identity.
features.priorEvidence: Google Maps search showed a housing complex and a residential-area result; neither establishes this polygon boundary or its Arabic name.

features.prayerMappingInterpretation: delegationId 387 resolves to Carthage in the app; administrative location is Le Kram (code 1170), within sector Sidi Amor (117056). Do not treat the prayer delegation as the administrative parent.
features.recommendation: Keep the explicit OSM neighbourhood point unresolved as a Latin-only selectable point; do not assign a speculative Arabic spelling.
features.reason: OSM explicitly tags place=neighbourhood and gives a single point, but provides no name:ar and no polygon boundary. INS confirms only the containing official sector Sidi Amor (117056), not Cité el Bank as a separately coded sector. Existing audit shows GPS can resolve only to Sidi Amor at this point.
features.evidenceGap: An Arabic municipality/local-authority name source for Cité el Bank and, if boundary-based GPS is required, a reviewed neighborhood polygon rather than an assumed buffer around this point.
features.priorEvidence: Google Maps name search for Cité el Bank/Le Kram returned bank results; these do not establish an Arabic toponym or boundary. Prior reliability audit row says coverageStatus=sector only and current GPS label سيدي عمر.

overall: All three are deferred unresolved. This package records insufficient evidence for first-release identity/naming; it does not assert that any locality is false or absent.
